definitions.gloss: ulcer; open sore on a body surface or lining
definitions.explanation: An open lesion or sore that forms on the surface of an organ or tissue, especially the lining of the stomach or intestines. Used in medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {胃|い}{潰瘍|かいよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was diagnosed with a gastric ulcer.

examples.japanese: {潰瘍|かいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}して→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}する→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The ulcer worsened and I had to be hospitalized.

examples.japanese: {胃|い}{潰瘍|かいよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧や⟦{暴飲暴食|ぼういんぼうしょく}→暴飲暴食：08061_bouinboushoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Gastric ulcers are often caused by stress and excessive eating and drinking.

notes:
Standard medical term for ulcers of various types.

TYPES:
- {胃|い}{潰瘍|かいよう}: gastric ulcer
- ⟦{十二指腸|じゅうにしちょう}→十二指腸：29068_juunishichou⟧{潰瘍|かいよう}: duodenal ulcer
- {口内|こうない}{潰瘍|かいよう}: oral ulcer, mouth sore
- ⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧{潰瘍|かいよう}: skin ulcer

NOTE: The homophone ⟦{海洋|かいよう}→海洋：00143_kaiyou⟧ (ocean) has the same pronunciation — context distinguishes them.
